allocation_policy.snapshot: All three base slot accounts before any grant. Ignore absent selection and absent cost. Super excluded.
allocation_policy.uncharged: Available, not full, value < 1; divide q by the number of these slots.
allocation_policy.extra_charge: Available, not full, value >= 1; q/3 independent of uncharged count.
allocation_policy.scaling: Apply each recipient gain profile after splitting; discard overflow without redistribution.
allocation_policy.ambiguity: Compendium says counts as charged and receives one third of regular energy, but does not resolve mixed-case denominators. This policy can give more than q across accounts before receiver scaling; do not claim a measured conserved total.
allocation_policy.older_test_scope: 2020 firsthand testing reported no energy beyond first charge. Historical contradiction only, not current numeric authority.

fixture_scope: wellspring_targets contains synthetic abilities and .75/.8/.5 receiver scalars. The class scalar is not a Destiny class ability calibration; full subclasses and current stat integration remain partial.
